title: Understand dispensing workflow
text: Follow the prescription from electronic arrival, pharmacist clinical check and in-stock pick list through the named basket, dispensing, any required accuracy check, packaging and patient notification. Understand the Pharmacy X dashboard and how it relates to the dispensing workflow.

title: One basket, one patient
text: Complete one patient basket before starting another routine task. If interrupted, secure the basket and leave a clear status handover. Keep the bench tidy. Coordinate scanning with colleagues. Prioritise ready baskets nearby unless clinical urgency or an agreed priority takes precedence.

title: Accuracy-check handover
text: Identify baskets awaiting accuracy checks and keep checked and unchecked items separate. Work within your role. When a controlled drug or refrigerated item requires an ACT check, tell the relevant colleague directly and identify the item. Follow the current SOP.

title: Split packs, expiry dates and leaflets
text: For split packs or medicine removed from original packaging, show the correct expiry on the supplied container or label, following product information and the local SOP. Never guess. Include the correct current PIL for the exact medicine, strength and formulation, particularly CDs and antibiotics.

title: Confidential waste
text: Put patient-identifiable paperwork, labels and tokens into the designated confidential-waste bin. Do not leave them on the bench or put them in general waste.

title: Package securely and add notices
text: Choose a secure bag without crushing packs. Separate refrigerated, bulky or fragile items appropriately. Seal the top with the patient information label and relevant notices, including exemptions, blood pressure service, refrigerated items or owing items. Pause to check patient, medicine, label and package.

title: Collection, Med Point and delivery labels
text: Use page 2 of the original illustrated guide. Counter collection: patient details at the bottom. Med Point: QR code at the corner of the triangle, not in the centre of the bottom section. Delivery: delivery QR and patient details at the bottom; avoid placing two QR codes together at the bottom.

title: Print or reprint the dispensing token
text: For Print rx, Print script, Reprint or Print DT labels: open the patient page, scroll to All Prescriptions, choose View for the relevant prescription, then print/reprint DT. Cut off the left side into confidential waste and place the right side inside the bag.

text:

title: Use PDS search
text: Learn how to carry out a PDS search. Postcode search tip: entering BH31* searches all BH31 postcodes, as described in the pharmacy training guidance.

text: Learn and practise how to put away items in Pharmacy X using the pharmacy’s agreed process.

text: Learn and practise how to print a receipt in Square Up.

text: Read the VP notification channel daily and keep up to date with its notices.

text: Understand the function of each Slack channel and which channel to use for each purpose.

title: Get a PIN from MedPoint
text: Learn how to get the PIN from MedPoint. Make sure you are giving the PIN to the right person, following the pharmacy’s identity-checking procedure.

title: Check MedPoint status and location
text: Learn how to check the status and location of an order in MedPoint.

title: Resend an order-ready message
text: Learn how to resend an order-ready message when stock has stayed in the MedPoint machine for too long, following the pharmacy’s agreed process.

title: Add and edit patient details in Pharmland Porto
text:
Use Pharmland Porto to add and edit patient details. Make sure the patient record includes:
1. Full name
2. Date of birth (DOB)
3. Phone number
4. Patient email address
5. Home address
6. NHS number
7. Referring doctor

Patient information is linked to Cliniko. Enter actual patient information in the approved patient system, not in this training record.

title: Add and reschedule an appointment
text: Learn how to add an appointment and reschedule an existing appointment in the appointment workflow.

title: Understand the Pharmland Porto / Cliniko link
text: Understand that patient information in Pharmland Porto is linked to Cliniko. Use Pharmland Porto to add and edit patient details.

title: Search for a medicine in Order Delivery Desk
text: Search for a drug to see whether it has been ordered and delivered.

title: Record a patient medicine request
text: When a patient asks for a medicine, write a note in Order Delivery Desk. Be specific about the medicine name and include the name and date in the note section. Keep actual patient details in the approved operational system, not in this learning record.

title: Sign off SOPs in PharmSmart
text: Find and sign off the required SOPs under the Governance category in PharmSmart. A training sign-off here does not sign the SOP in PharmSmart.

title: Understand PharmSmart functions
text: Know how PharmSmart is used to report misses / near misses and to log cleaning and expired stock.
